# Server coming soon!

We’re preparing the next shared Mythforge adventure. Watch Discord for launch news.

 [Explore the modpack](https://mythforge.win/modpack/)  [Join Discord ↗](https://discord.gg/QQwdEgFMFg)

## A shared horizon ahead.

Mythforge’s engineering, magic, building and adventure are designed with multiplayer in mind. Build a workshop together, compare magical discoveries or prepare for the next boss as a group. The planned official public server gives that freedom a shared home.

## An adventure worth sharing.

Careful integration, quality-of-life and a strong sense of discovery make Mythforge an inviting choice for friends seeking a long-term NeoForge world. Gather ideas now and watch Discord for launch details. Server coming soon!

While we prepare the server,  [get to know Mythforge](https://mythforge.win/modpack/)  and  [install the pack](https://mythforge.win/getting-started/)  to explore on your own or with friends.
